title: Developer Update
description:
Your browser will cap FPS at 60 and lower performance. I suggest installing the Windows version if you can for higher FPS and faster speeds.

North Africa is the focus of this week's build. The nation's that see changes include Britain, France, Morocco and the Ottomans. The Atlantic, Central Med and Eastern Med sea nodes have been updated to include new ports.
